_comment: Coverage floors enforced by scripts/check-coverage.ts (warren-e4b1, pl-7b06 step 17). Set just below the current baseline to absorb measurement noise. The ratchet only goes UP — raise these numbers as coverage improves. Exception: warren-b8bf (pl-3a79 step 8) deleted ~7.4k LOC of well-tested plot code, moving the lines baseline from 92.73% to ~91.96% and functions to 89.33%; both floors lowered accordingly. Exception: the lines floor had gone stale ABOVE its own stated purpose — measured 91.85 while the real baseline on HEAD was 91.39%, so no commit could pass and the gate blocked every change regardless of merit. Measured on HEAD with all working-tree changes stashed (lines 91.39 / functions 89.57) and on a branch that only ADDS tests-covered code (91.40 / 89.55): the same within noise, i.e. the drop is not attributable to that branch. The lines floor is now set just below that baseline, restoring the definition above; the ratchet resumes from 91.35. functions is unchanged at 89.3 because it already passes with ~0.25pp of headroom, and raising it would only add flapping risk.
